approaches_tried.approach: Raw string concatenation of chunk_*.md files (no separator)
approaches_tried.reason: Glues the last char of one chunk directly onto the first char of the next, manufacturing spurious [a-z].[A-Z] boundary matches: bacon_a_case read 25 instead of 10, bacon_dorr_2024 read 7 instead of 0. Switched to "\n\n".join() which reproduces the research report's baseline figures exactly (7/10/0/11/21).

deviations.description: Concatenate ~/Projects/Literature/sources/{doc}/chunk_*.md in lexicographic order and report the count.
deviations.reason: The plan's literal phrasing ("concatenate ... in lexicographic order") reads as raw concatenation, but raw concatenation glues adjacent chunk boundaries and manufactures spurious [a-z].[A-Z] matches (measured: bacon_a_case 25 vs 10, bacon_dorr_2024 7 vs 0). Switched to "\n\n".join() of the chunk texts, which reproduces the research report's baseline figures exactly on all five fixtures.
